hook.text: 1.4 billion people use an internet without Google, Facebook, or YouTube. China built a parallel digital universe.

buildup.text: The Great Firewall blocks foreign websites and filters domestic content.

discovery.text: China substituted banned platforms with domestic ones: Baidu, WeChat, Weibo.

twist.text: VPNs let some Chinese citizens bypass the firewall.

climax.text: China proved that a modern economy can function with a censored internet.

punchline.text: Connect a billion people. Control what they see.

quiz.question: What did China's Great Firewall disprove?
options: That censorship can exist in the digital age
That internet access automatically leads to political freedom
That domestic tech companies can succeed
